So a friend and i were playing hero league and we ended up getting a full burst team. We figured we would do okay and for the most part we did. Where about do you think our downfall was? https://youtu.be/Ao8s5kDXT6E

A lot of things:

  • "We have to team fight, and we aren't doing that" is what one of you said, with your comp split pushing is very difficult. Nazeebo + Uther top and rest bot is best option for split push you had but Jaina + Johanna can over power that fairly easily. You have no options for controlling team fights or boxing in enemies during a team fight, you're all trying to play back line which means you're constantly losing ground unless you have number advantage.

  • Poor map awareness and positioning overall was a big strike against your team. Not being ready for objectives and being off sides out of position and aimless map roaming really hurt you in that they got ganks and you weren't soaking EXP. Raynor being caught over extended roaming middle area by ilidan is an example of bad positioning and map awareness. Missing a chance to prep for immortal arrival and Valla poking enemy team during immortal fight serving no purpose is an example of poor objective control. Over all poor team work and movement really hurt you.

  • Overall mechanics; Saw a lot of missed skill shots by Raynor. Valla poor heroic ability utilization; starting a team fight with it and using it after Murky was running away. Those are the obvious examples. Aside from positioning, map awareness, and objective control, your mechanics need work.

  • Something to watch out for especially when facing certain hero combos like Johanna + Jaina is that 1) Condemn cancels your channel abilities like Strafe and 2) The combo Condemn + Punish + Blizzard is super deadly to your team comp full of squishies. Knowing how to play to their team comp weaknesses or avoid their strengths is just as important as knowing how to play to your team comp strengths.
